title: Insectokil Smoke Bombs (Pack of 4) Mini Smoke Bomb Foggers For Effective Control Of All Flying And Crawling Insects
bullet_points: KILLS ALL FLYING & CRAWLING INSECTS: Each Insectokil smoke bomb has a proven coverage of 120metres squared. The fumigators Create a fine, penetrating mist that reaches deep into the cracks and crevices to kill the insects both in and out of sight.

HEALTH & SAFETY APPROVED: InsectoKil uses Permethrin to kill insects in your home and workplaces. This product is HSE approved. Light the smoke bomb, place it on a heat proof surface and leave the room for up to 2 Hours.

SIMPLE, NON-STAINING & EASY TO USE: Simply light the non-sparking wick and smoke fumes will begin to work their way into all the nooks and crannies killing all flying and crawling insects in the treated area. Once treatment is complete, open doors and windows to ventilate thoroughly.

FLEA SMOKE BOMBS FOR THE HOME: Fleas are tough pests to get completely eradicate. They can be particularly challenging to get rid of due to their resilient eggs, making our smoke bombs a crucial part of your comprehensive pest control strategy.
WHERE TO USE: Use in enclosed spaces such as bedrooms, apartments, attics, basements, barns, cellars, cabins, campers, crawl spaces, garages, homes, households, sheds, storage areas and trailers.
description: Welcome to InsectoKil Are pesky insects causing you trouble in your home or office? Look no further because InsectoKil has your ultimate solution! Our easy-to-use insect smoke bomb fumigator is the most effective way to eliminate a wide range of crawling and flying pests, ensuring a pest-free environment for you and your loved ones. Say Goodbye to Pest Problems InsectoKil's smoke bomb fumigator is designed to tackle a variety of bothersome insects, including: Fleas Bed bugs Ants Cockroaches Mites Earwigs Moths Silverfish Beetles And many more... Simple Application, Powerful Results Using InsectoKil is a breeze. Here's how to use it: Clear people, plants, and all animals from the area to be treated. Place each fumigator on a fireproof base (as these can get hot). Light the smoke bomb, place it on a heat-proof surface, and exit the room for up to 2-5 hours. After treatment is complete, open doors and windows to thoroughly ventilate the area. Trusted Ingredients InsectoKil's smoke bomb fumigator contains the following ingredients: Permethrin 13.35% w/w: A highly effective insecticide that targets and eliminates a wide range of pests. Potassium chlorate: Helps create the smoke necessary to reach and eradicate hidden insects. Take control of your pest problem with InsectoKil's reliable and convenient smoke bomb fumigator. Enjoy a pest-free environment, whether at home or in the office, and finally put an end to those troublesome insect infestations!
